rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice for a smooth surface that looks shiny or glossy.

example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 dei6 baan2 ling6 ling6 dei2 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for something that sparkles or glitters by reflecting light.

example.english: The car is shiny after being waxed.
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 daa2 laap6 zi1 hau6 sim2 ling6 ling6

rows.note: Use this when the thing is bright because it is giving off light.

example.english: The moon is shiny and lights up the night.
example.jyutping: jyut6 loeng6 hai2 je6 hung1 zung1 faat3 gwong1

rows.note: Use this slangy everyday adjective when shiny means excellent or impressive rather than literally reflective.

example.english: Your new jacket is shiny—in a really cool way.
example.jyutping: nei5 gin6 san1 ngoi6 tou3 hou2 zeng3 wo3
